# Anti-AI-Slop Design Guide & Quality Gate — Mohasba Tracker v2

**Purpose:** Permanent design quality reference & review checklist for Phase 3 (UX/Prototype) and Phase 7 (Production Next.js UI), ensuring Mohasba Tracker v2 reads as a genuinely human-crafted, purpose-built Arabic RTL product—never a generic AI template.  
**Related Spec:** [docs/02-ux-design-system.md](file:///d:/Ahmed/Projects/mohasba/docs/02-ux-design-system.md)  
**Last Updated:** 2026-11-20

---

## 1. What Is "AI Slop Design"? (Definition)

**AI Slop Design** is UI generated by optimizing for the **statistical median** of scraped templates (Tailwind/shadcn kits, Dribbble posters, v0/Lovable/Bolt defaults) rather than deriving visual decisions from the product's actual **physical environment**, **user task**, and **cultural vernacular**.

Users recognize it in under half a second because it looks *over-styled yet functionally generic*—wearing borrowed visual costumes instead of earning its layout, palette, and typography from the job at hand.

In **2025–2026**, AI slop appears in **two distinct waves**:

1. **Wave 1 — The Generic SaaS Default:**
   - Default `indigo-500 → purple-600` gradients used as an automatic "modern tech" badge.
   - Uniform `rounded-2xl` shadowed bento cards ("Card Hell") wrapping every group and KPI.
   - Pure/tinted black (`#000` / `#0B0B0B`) dark modes lit by neon halos, blurred radial blobs, and gratuitous `backdrop-blur` frosted glass.
   - Raw Unicode emojis (`✨`, `🚀`, `🔥`, `👋`) and tinted Lucide icon squares stamped beside every heading or metric.

2. **Wave 2 — The "Human-Washed" Editorial Cliché:**
   - When users grew tired of purple SaaS templates, models over-corrected into a new algorithmic default: **warm cream/beige grounds (`#F4F1EA` / `#F7F6F2`)**, **terracotta/warm-clay accents (`#D97757`)**, trendy editorial serif displays, and broadsheet hairlines—applied blindly regardless of whether the product is an outdoor daytime street utility or a dense data ledger.
   - *(Case Study in This Project: Our own initial `Warm Paper #F7F6F2` draft fell into Wave-2 AI slop AND washed out in midday outdoor sunlight. We explicitly scrapped `#F7F6F2` and replaced it with **Cool Mineral Chalk `#F3F5F6` + `#FFFFFF`** for daylight legibility and **Nocturnal Basalt `#121619`** for low-glare Fajr/Isha logging.)*

---

## 2. Top 10 Concrete Tells of AI Slop (2025–2026)

1. **Purple / Indigo Gradient Monopoly:** Unmotivated `indigo → purple` buttons, badges, or background washes.
2. **Wave-2 Cream / Beige Default (`#F4F1EA` / `#F7F6F2`) + Terracotta (`#D97757`):** Used as an ungrounded "calm/craft" costume.
3. **"Card Hell" Uniform Bento Grids:** Every section, habit group, or row wrapped in identical `rounded-2xl` containers with soft `shadow-sm` (`rgba(0,0,0,0.1)`), destroying hierarchy and wasting mobile/table density.
4. **Neon Dark Mode & Decorative Glows:** `#000`/`#0B0B0B` backgrounds with zero-offset glowing `box-shadow` halos, ambient orbs, or decorative `backdrop-blur`.
5. **Emoji Clutter & Decorative Icon Squares:** Raw emojis (`✅`, `❌️`, `🔘`, `✨`, `🔥`, `☀️`, `🌙`) standing in for an icon system, or tiny colored icon boxes beside labels that carry zero state information.
6. **Generic Template Micro-Chrome:** Tracked-out `ALL-CAPS` eyebrow/kicker labels above headings (an explicit ban), middle-dot meta strings (`A · B · C`), spaced em-dash titles (`WORD — fragment`), trailing `→` arrows on buttons/links, and `monospace` forced onto non-numeric labels.
7. **The Predictable Dashboard Formula:** Left sidebar + top search bar + *"Good morning"* greeting + 4 identical KPI cards + line chart + table—regardless of whether the real task requires `<3s` one-thumb logging or a 50-row weekly matrix.
8. **Typographic Flatness or Display Misuse:** Same weight/size ratios everywhere, or calligraphic/serif display fonts shoved into dense data tables and controls.
9. **Gratuitous Motion & Choreography:** Staggered fade-and-slide-up page-load animations, hover-bounce cards, and slow transitions (`>250ms`) that actively obstruct an Operate-mode daily tool.
10. **Filler / Cheerleading Copy:** Marketing verbs (*"Supercharge"*, *"Unlock"*), vague empty states (*"Nothing here yet ✨"*), or apologetic errors instead of direct, active-verb UI language.

## 3. Conditions for Zero AI Slop in Mohasba Tracker v2 (Mandatory Checklist)

Every Phase 3 prototype and Phase 7 Next.js production screen MUST pass all six categories below before sign-off:

### A. Palette, Surfaces & Contrast
- [ ] **Ban Wave-1 & Wave-2 Defaults:** Zero purple/indigo gradients, zero `#F4F1EA` / `#F7F6F2` beige grounds, zero terracotta `#D97757`, zero neon glow halos, zero `backdrop-blur` glass decoration.
- [ ] **Two Grounded Environmental Modes:**
  - **Light Mode (Daylight Street & PC Matrix):** `#F3F5F6` canvas, `#FFFFFF` ledger surface, `#E9EDF0` subtle headers, `#D5DCE1` `1px` hairlines, `#11161A` deep ink, `#0F5257` Aegean Petrol live accent.
  - **Dark Mode (Fajr / Isha Night Logging):** `#121619` Nocturnal Basalt canvas (never `#000`/`#0B0B0B`), `#191F24` surface, `#20282F` subtle headers, `#2A343C` hairlines, `#E6EBEF` soft mist ink (88% white to avoid Fajr halation), `#5BA4AA` muted sea-slate live accent.
- [ ] **Quarantine Warm Tints:** Warm ochre `#FBF2E6` is strictly confined to small `PERCENT` state cells/chips—never allowed on page, banner, or card backgrounds.
- [ ] **Semantic States Never Color-Alone:** Every canonical state (`DONE`, `MISSED`, `QADAA_DONE`, `PERCENT`, `DISABLED`, `PENDING`, `UNLOGGED_EXPIRED`) pairs a distinct `1.5px` SVG glyph + `1px` border + subtle `~10%` tint passing **WCAG AA (`>= 4.5:1`)** in both Light and Dark.
- [ ] **Elevation Declared Once:** Zero resting drop shadows on cards, panels, or lists (`1px` hairline + tonal surface steps only). Soft offset shadows are reserved strictly for transient overlays (`5s Undo` toast, native `<dialog>` editors). Zero colored `border-left` / `border-right` strips thicker than `1px`.

### B. Structure, Density & Radius Discipline
- [ ] **Zero Card-in-Card Nesting:** Street Mode renders flat full-width grouped rows separated by `1px` dividers (`divide-y`), not stacked shadowed cards. Desktop Matrix renders a true collapsible grouped 50-row table (`36–38px` row height) with a `2px` structural rule isolating Right-side prayer periods from Left-side open habits.
- [ ] **Hierarchical Border Radii:** `2px` (matrix cells & state badges), `6px` (buttons, inline `✓/✕` taps, day strip tiles, inputs), `8px` (group panels, `<dialog>`, Undo toast). `9999px` is **strictly quarantined** to the `6px` WHOOP 7-day dots and `6–7px` live/sync status dots.
- [ ] **Zero Ornamental Clichés:** No Islamic arch SVGs, geometric arabesque wallpapers, crescent sparkles, or `repeating-linear-gradient` stripe textures.
- [ ] **Strict RTL Logical CSS:** `dir="rtl"`, `padding-inline-*`, `margin-inline-*`, `inset-inline-*`, `border-inline-*`, `text-align: start/end` everywhere. Explicit `dir="ltr"` on numeric time ranges (`14:43 - 17:01`) so bidi never flips start/end times.

### C. Typography, Icons & Arabic Copy
- [ ] **Single Workhorse Arabic Sans:** **`Readex Pro`** (`400/500/600/700`) with a tight fixed `rem` scale (`12px / 13px / 15px / 17px / 20px` — no fluid `clamp()`).
- [ ] **Tabular Numerals Everywhere:** `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on every percentage, countdown, Qadaa age, and matrix rate column.
- [ ] **Uniform `1.5px` SVG Icon System:** Zero raw Unicode emojis in headers, buttons, navigation, or matrix cells.
- [ ] **Zero Template Micro-Chrome:** Zero eyebrows/kickers above headings, zero `·` middle-dot strings, zero `—` em-dash titles, zero trailing `→` button arrows.
- [ ] **Direct Active-Verb Arabic Copy:** Buttons name the exact result (`تم ما في المسجد`, `تم الفترة بالكامل`, `ترحيل المنتهي للقضاء`, `تطوير الهدف`, `تراجع`), matching the 5s Undo toast verbatim. Empty states state facts clearly (`لا توجد فوائت قضاء مفتوحة حالياً`).

### D. Operate-Mode Interaction, Browser Surfaces & Restraint
- [ ] **Spend Boldness in One Place:** Our sole signature craft detail is the **`2px` Time-Window Horizon Rail (`شريط أفق الفترة الموقوت`)** embedded into the bottom edge of the active prayer header (Aegean Petrol normally, Harvest Ochre in the final 25 minutes). Everything around it stays quiet and functional.
- [ ] **Zero Page-Load Choreography:** Instant entry into the active prayer window (`<3s` flow); state-only transitions at `150–180ms`; honors `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- [ ] **Themed Browser Surfaces:** Custom `::selection`, `caret-color`, `:focus-visible`, `text-underline-offset`, and clean palette scrollbars.
- [ ] **Dual Desktop & Mobile Parity:** Verified simultaneously at **`390px`** (mobile bottom bar, `44px × 44px` tap targets, zero horizontal overflow, WHOOP 7-day circle ledger) and **`1440px`** (RTL inline-start rail, collapsible 50-row table, zero duplicate header controls).
- [ ] **Zero Audio / Music:** Strictly silent UI.

## 4. Non-Overlapping Skill Workflow (`/frontend-design` + `/impeccable`)

| Skill | Exact Ownership (Zero Overlap) | When Applied |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`/frontend-design`** | Visual World (*Al-Mizan Al-Ma'dani*), Light/Dark hex palette, Arabic typography + `tabular-nums`, the ONE signature craft detail (`2px` Horizon Rail), two-pass anti-slop critique, and plain-verb Arabic microcopy. | Phase 3 (Visual Direction & Prototype) + Phase 7 (guarding against Tailwind/shadcn defaults during Next.js build) |
| **`/impeccable`** | `Operate`-Mode UX architecture (`operate.md`, `shape`), pre-edit `craft-floor.md` floor, mechanical detector (`impeccable.cmd detect --json`), dual-viewport visual & RTL/WCAG `audit`, `critique`, `harden`, `adapt`, `polish`, and generating final `DESIGN.md` via `document`. | Phase 3 (Prototype Gate: `detect --json` = `[]`) + Phase 7–8 (Production Next.js Ship Gate + final `DESIGN.md`) |

---

## 5. Mandatory Verification Gate (Before Any UI Ships)

1. Run **`impeccable.cmd detect --json <target files>`** → must return **`[]`** (zero unresolved mechanical AI-slop / craft-floor findings).
2. Render in a real browser at BOTH **`1440×900` (Desktop)** and **`390×844` (Mobile)** in **Light AND Dark modes**:
   - Confirm **`0` console errors** and **`scrollWidth <= innerWidth` (`overflow: false`)**.
   - Visually inspect rendered screenshots as a batched check and fix every spacing, contrast, bidi, or duplication flaw before handoff.
